predict.question: You have 30 minutes to compare options. Each one takes one minute to set up and four minutes to inspect, and only fully inspected options count. How many minutes do you spend inspecting?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: The Art of Choosing examines how options and decision contexts shape choosing.
modelBoundary: Short looks use {A} inspecting; longer looks {B}. Longer chunks repeat the setup less often, within the same budget.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? More inspection time need not produce a better real choice.
